label: test: current file
command: if [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *.test.* ]] || [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *_test.* ]] || [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *_spec.rb ]]; then file="$ZED_FILE"; else file=$(echo "$ZED_FILE" | sed 's/\.\([^.]*\)$/.test.\1/'); fi; if [[ "$file" == *.rb ]]; then bundle exec rspec "$file"; elif [[ "$file" == *.ts ]] || [[ "$file" == *.tsx ]]; then npx vitest run "$file"; fi

label: test: nearest
command: if [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *.rb ]]; then bundle exec rspec "$ZED_FILE:$ZED_ROW"; elif [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *.ts ]] || [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then npx vitest run "$ZED_FILE" -t "$ZED_SYMBOL"; fi
